text: Handles the branch in words (reply No, or answer three more things) with a one-line example; fine for one person, awkward to collect consistently from a team.
a2ui: All the inputs exist, but the basic catalog has no conditional visibility, so the if-you-are-coming questions are always shown with a caption telling people to skip them.
html: The follow-up questions slide open only on Yes, hotel nights appear only with the hotel switch, and a live sentence reads the RSVP back before sending.
agui: Rules show the details only when attending and the nights only when a hotel is needed, and the if/then in the output schema makes shirt size required only for attendees.
